engine.description: The database engine in use; mysql is MySQL or MariaDB.

version.description: The server version of the database.

source.description: env: DB_* environment variables (moves are locked); file: /data/npmpro/database.json; default: /data/npmpro/database.sqlite

host.description: Server host name or address (MySQL and PostgreSQL).

ssl.description: The TLS settings of the connection (MySQL and PostgreSQL), as in a move target.

size.description: Bytes, when the engine reports it

moved_at.description: When NPMpro was last moved to this database; null if it never was.

name.description: The database name before the move (the file for SQLite).

moved_from.description: Where it was moved from (engine, and host and name for a server); null if it never was moved.

rows.description: The number of rows in the table.

tables.description: Every table with its number of rows.

move.description: The current or last database move; null when none ran since the backend started.
